scripts.check: biome format tests vitest.config.mjs && npm run check --workspaces --if-present && npm run build && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf coverage/node && mkdir -p coverage/node/raw && NODE_V8_COVERAGE="$PWD/coverage/node/raw" NODE_OPTIONS="--import=$PWD/tests/coverage/flush.mjs" vitest run && c8 report --config tests/coverage/node.c8rc.json
